aggregates.count: how many rows have a value
aggregates.count_distinct: how many different values there are

query.numbers_only: {aggregate} works on numbers, and {column} holds {type_name} values

filter.no_condition: Type the rest of the condition, for example > 100
filter.no_values: Type at least one value - separate several with commas
filter.not_a_number: {target} holds numbers, and "{value}" is not one

join_kinds.inner: only the rows that match in both tables
join_kinds.left: every row of the first table, with or without a match

query.filter_left_out: The filter on {target} is left out: {problem}
query.not_joined: {table} is not joined to {tables}, so every row of it is paired with every row of the others. Choose the fields to join it on with Join… below - or link it on the diagram.

table_state.type_unknown: '{field}': its exact type is not known, so its NULL setting cannot be changed here. Read the database again (⟳) and try once more.
table_state.computed: '{field}' is computed by the database: its NULL setting cannot be changed.
table_state.remedy_default: give the field a default value (⋮ next to it → Default value…)
table_state.remedy_fill: choose a value for them (⋮ next to the field → Require a value…)
table_state.rows_not_shown: '{field}' requires a value (NOT NULL), and '{table}' may have more rows than are shown here. To be sure each gets one, {remedy}.
table_state.row_without_value: '{field}' requires a value (NOT NULL), and row {rows} has none. Type a value in each, or {remedy}.
table_state.rows_without_value: '{field}' requires a value (NOT NULL), and rows {rows} have none. Type a value in each, or {remedy}.

links.same_table: {source} and {target} are in the same table: link a field to a key of another table.
links.no_primary_key: Neither {source} nor {target} is a primary key (PK). A link goes from a field to the primary key of another table - use Join… in the query panel to join on other fields.
links.different_kinds: {parent} holds {parent_type} values and {child} holds {child_type} values: a link needs fields that hold the same kind of values.

permissions.select_role: read the tables and their rows
